scope: Outbound preservation, panel access validation, entitlement share readiness, certificate caching/references, upgrade completion across restart, scheduler projections and obsolete workflow cleanup

environment.host: Windows amd64, Intel i5-9400F, Go 1.27.3, Node 24.18.0
environment.linux: Dedicated Ubuntu amd64 VM, QEMU TCG, 2 vCPU / 2 GiB
environment.browser: Real Chrome, desktop 1280x900 and mobile viewport 390x844

checks.windows_go_test_all: passed: go test ./..., short TEMP/TMP/GOTMPDIR avoids Unix socket path length failures
checks.outbound_grpc_and_unknown_http_transport: passed: changing only tag preserves all other fields; copying uses the same preservation rules
checks.panel_initialization_before_write_valida: passed: invalid port and reverse-proxy origin are rejected without committed configuration
checks.share_readiness_after_unbind: passed: unbound creation rejected, existing usage reports no_bound_inbound, configuration download returns 403
checks.panel_certificate_rotation_and_expiry: passed: incomplete rotation preserves valid cached pair; complete rotation refreshes; expired pair is rejected
checks.upgrade_receipt_recovery: passed: success, rollback and rollback failure, wrong target rejected, duplicate consumption preserves final state and releases control lane
checks.upgrade_wait_timeout: passed: cutoff boundary, explicit failed result, late success cannot overwrite timeout, control lane becomes available
checks.panel_health: passed: ready worker required, Host and local socket peer checked; includes specific non-loopback local interface
checks.subscription_schedule_projection: passed: deadlines decoded without reading local node file or constructing unrelated node/body objects
checks.linux_amd64_new_go_regressions: passed using cross-compiled manage test executable in dedicated VM
checks.linux_program_upgrade_script: passed: stopped, active, early rollback, deferred panel success, rollback and rollback failure receipts
checks.shellcheck: passed at CI warning severity: shellcheck --severity=warning sb.sh install.sh lib/*.sh scripts/*.sh
checks.real_isolated_panel_api: passed: bind-before-share workflow, entitlement rename, expiration fields, quota/count denial and archive revision conflicts
checks.real_browser: passed: mouse, keyboard, touch, adjacent-button click with open menu, entitlement editing, quota rejection, no horizontal overflow; desktop/mobile screenshots inspected

subscription_schedule_benchmark.fixture: 4096 cached source nodes plus 4096 local nodes, same files and environment for both paths
subscription_schedule_benchmark.limit: Metadata read only. Runtime JSON is still scanned. These values do not measure proxy throughput, production latency, process RSS or sustained load.

Previous obsolete caches remain under .cleanup-manual. No cleanup material is tracked by Git.
cleanup.retained: In-use toolchains, QEMU, validation qcow2 and its Ubuntu backing disk, VM SSH/seed assets, valid source fixtures and third-party licenses

remote_ci: Local verification record; check the CI run attached to the pushed main commit separately. Earlier successful commits are not evidence for this change.
